title: Designing Idempotent Celery Tasks
question: A Celery task sends a welcome email. Due to a retry, it fires twice and the user gets two emails. How do you design the task to be idempotent using a check-then-act pattern or a unique database constraint?

title: Diagnosing Silent Celery Task Failures
question: A Celery task is failing but you see no errors anywhere. Walk through at least three reasons why exceptions can be silently swallowed in Celery and how to fix each one.

title: Routing Celery Tasks to Priority Queues
question: You have fast tasks (send notification) and slow tasks (video transcoding) competing for the same workers. Show how to use task_routes to send each to a dedicated queue with separate workers.

title: Celery Task Calling External API with Retry on Transient Errors
question: Write a Celery task that calls an external payment API. It should retry with exponential backoff on ConnectionError or 429, not retry on 400, and fail permanently on 401.

title: Diagnosing and Fixing Memory Leaks in Celery Workers
question: Your Celery workers gradually consume more memory and need to be restarted every hour. What are the common causes, and how do you use worker_max_memory_per_child and worker_max_tasks_per_child to mitigate this?
